page.overview:
Who is Thaisha Lloy?

(pronounced TIE-sha /[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA/English `taɪʃə]/) is an orc druid of the Circle of Ancients played by Aabria Iyengar in Campaign Four.

Thaisha is 6'4" tall and appears to be in her mid-to-late 30s due to her aging being slower than normal, with desaturated green skin and long, curly, dark (but graying) hair. Her eyes are completely black with red-ringed silver irises. The tips of her fingers are red and black, with metallic ends on each of her nails and a red decorative pattern on her hands. She wears fine clothing with those same colors, associated with her family. In one of her ears she has a steel spine piercing through two different points. She also has visible metal plates where her vertebrae are, and they seem to warm up and turn red hot when she's angry or tense.

She is honest, fierce, and ferociously protective and maternal toward those she considers family. She is also very proud of her status as a Lloy. She hopes "that she can heal the lands that were damaged by the death of the Shapers, and in so doing, lead the world and the people who still miss the weight and heft of divinity to realize that that's always existed within the world and within themselves." When she returns home, she's always surprised "by how much her family has changed without her, and feels the disconnect between her mission and the thing she gave up to pursue it." Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 08:26}} She tends to be more cheery around nature, and whenever she leaves the city, she spends a brief period of "mourning" for a couple of days leaving behind the personality she displays around her friends and family there.

Having been born as part of a remarkable family and being in a position of influence as a druid of the Circle of Ancients, Thaisha has never had the need to lie about herself and isn't very skilled at it; moreover, the combination of her good intentions and her privilege creates in her a certain expectation that people will be nice to her. Her biggest flaw is that she believes that her wisdom makes her able to see and understand everything perfectly regardless of perspective. Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|1:33:39}}
